The '''fuel rods''' were [[isotope-5]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] bars developed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], around the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. The rods enabled [[the Ark]] to fly into [[Starship/Legends|space]].
